title: Indian Affairs: Legal Framework for Probate and Other Factors Limit Interior’s Options to Improve Its Process
summary:
What GAO Found

GAO’s analysis of the Department of the Interior’s probate data shows that its ongoing probate caseload grew from about 19,000 cases in October 2013, to about 55,000 cases in April 2026. This was due, in part, to an increase in case files in the case preparation phase, the first stage in the probate process after reporting a death, and a decrease in the number of probate hearings held. GAO found that 80 percent of nationwide probate cases were in the preparation phase.

summary:
What GAO Found

In general, GAO’s review of 11 studies found that publicly funded preschool programs contribute to children’s readiness for kindergarten in literacy, math, or both. Specifically, 10 studies found positive associations between preschool programs and kindergarten literacy scores, and seven of the studies that assessed math scores also found positive associations with these scores.
